meta.title: Zork I — world model (rooms, exits, objects)
meta.notes: Stages 3.1–3.2 deterministic extraction: all ROOM forms (exits, flags, scenery/pseudo references, exit-condition globals) and all OBJECT forms (properties, flags, containment, initial locations; ZIL scaffolding objects GLOBAL-OBJECTS/LOCAL-GLOBALS/ROOMS represented structurally, not as objects). Vocabulary, tables, and behavior are later stages. Generated by ir/src/extract-world.ts — do not edit by hand.

exits.message: The door is boarded and you can't remove the boards.

rooms.name: Stone Barrow
rooms.description: You are standing in front of a massive barrow of stone. In the east face is a huge stone door which is open. You cannot see into the dark of the tomb.

rooms.name: North of House

exits.message: The windows are all boarded.

rooms.description: You are facing the north side of a white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded up. To the north a narrow path winds through the trees.

rooms.name: South of House

exits.message: The windows are all boarded.

rooms.description: You are facing the south side of a white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded.

rooms.name: Forest

exits.message: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.
You would need a machete to go further west.

rooms.description: This is a forest, with trees in all directions. To the east, there appears to be sunlight.

rooms.name: Forest

exits.message: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.
The forest becomes impenetrable to the north.

rooms.description: This is a dimly lit forest, with large trees all around.

rooms.name: Forest

exits.message: The mountains are impassable.
The mountains are impassable.

rooms.description: The forest thins out, revealing impassable mountains.

rooms.name: Forest

exits.message: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.
The rank undergrowth prevents eastward movement.
Storm-tossed trees block your way.

rooms.description: This is a dimly lit forest, with large trees all around.

rooms.name: Forest Path
rooms.description: This is a path winding through a dimly lit forest. The path heads north-south here. One particularly large tree with some low branches stands at the edge of the path.

exits.message: You cannot climb any higher.
The forest becomes impenetrable to the north.

rooms.name: Clearing

exits.message: There is no tree here suitable for climbing.

rooms.description: You are in a small clearing in a well marked forest path that extends to the east and west.

exits.else: Only Santa Claus climbs down chimneys.

rooms.name: Attic
rooms.description: This is the attic. The only exit is a stairway leading down.

exits.message: You try to ascend the ramp, but it is impossible, and you slide back down.

rooms.name: The Troll Room

exits.else: The troll fends you off with a menacing gesture.
The troll fends you off with a menacing gesture.

rooms.description: This is a small room with passages to the east and south and a forbidding hole leading west. Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.

rooms.name: East of Chasm

exits.message: The chasm probably leads straight to the infernal regions.

rooms.description: You are on the east edge of a chasm, the bottom of which cannot be seen. A narrow passage goes north, and the path you are on continues to the east.

rooms.name: Gallery
rooms.description: This is an art gallery. Most of the paintings have been stolen by vandals with exceptional taste. The vandals left through either the north or west exits.

rooms.name: Studio
rooms.description: This appears to have been an artist's studio. The walls and floors are splattered with paints of 69 different colors. Strangely enough, nothing of value is hanging here. At the south end of the room is an open door (also covered with paint). A dark and narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although you might be able to get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back down.

rooms.name: Maze
rooms.description: This is part of a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

exits.else: The east wall is solid rock.
The cyclops doesn't look like he'll let you past.

rooms.name: Strange Passage
rooms.description: This is a long passage. To the west is one entrance. On the east there is an old wooden door, with a large opening in it (about cyclops sized).

rooms.name: Treasure Room
rooms.description: This is a large room, whose east wall is solid granite. A number of discarded bags, which crumble at your touch, are scattered about on the floor. There is an exit down a staircase.

exits.message: The dam blocks your way.

rooms.name: Stream View

exits.message: The stream emerges from a spot too small for you to enter.

rooms.description: You are standing on a path beside a gently flowing stream. The path follows the stream, which flows from west to east.

rooms.name: Stream

exits.message: The channel is too narrow.
The channel is too narrow.

rooms.description: You are on the gently flowing stream. The upstream route is too narrow to navigate, and the downstream route is invisible due to twisting walls. There is a narrow beach to land on.

rooms.name: Cave
rooms.description: This is a tiny cave with entrances west and north, and a staircase leading down.

rooms.name: Cave
rooms.description: This is a tiny cave with entrances west and north, and a dark, forbidding staircase leading down.

rooms.name: Cold Passage
rooms.description: This is a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway turns into a southward path.

rooms.name: Narrow Passage
rooms.description: This is a long and narrow corridor where a long north-south passageway briefly narrows even further.

rooms.name: Winding Passage
rooms.description: This is a winding passage. It seems that there are only exits on the east and north.

rooms.name: Twisting Passage
rooms.description: This is a winding passage. It seems that there are only exits on the east and north.

rooms.name: Atlantis Room
rooms.description: This is an ancient room, long under water. There is an exit to the south and a staircase leading up.

rooms.name: East-West Passage
rooms.description: This is a narrow east-west passageway. There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.

rooms.name: Round Room
rooms.description: This is a circular stone room with passages in all directions. Several of them have unfortunately been blocked by cave-ins.

rooms.name: Damp Cave

exits.message: It is too narrow for most insects.

rooms.description: This cave has exits to the west and east, and narrows to a crack toward the south. The earth is particularly damp here.

rooms.name: North-South Passage
rooms.description: This is a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.

rooms.name: Chasm

exits.message: Are you out of your mind?

rooms.description: A chasm runs southwest to northeast and the path follows it. You are on the south side of the chasm, where a crack opens into a passage.

exits.else: Some invisible force prevents you from passing through the gate.
Some invisible force prevents you from passing through the gate.

rooms.name: Land of the Dead
rooms.description: You have entered the Land of the Living Dead. Thousands of lost souls can be heard weeping and moaning. In the corner are stacked the remains of dozens of previous adventurers less fortunate than yourself. A passage exits to the north.

rooms.name: Engravings Cave
rooms.description: You have entered a low cave with passages leading northwest and east.

rooms.name: Egyptian Room
rooms.description: This is a room which looks like an Egyptian tomb. There is an ascending staircase to the west.

exits.else: You cannot go down without fracturing many bones.

exits.message: You cannot reach the rope.

rooms.name: Temple
rooms.description: This is the north end of a large temple. On the east wall is an ancient inscription, probably a prayer in a long-forgotten language. Below the prayer is a staircase leading down. The west wall is solid granite. The exit to the north end of the room is through huge marble pillars.

rooms.name: Altar

exits.else: You haven't a prayer of getting the coffin down there.

rooms.description: This is the south end of a large temple. In front of you is what appears to be an altar. In one corner is a small hole in the floor which leads into darkness. You probably could not get back up it.

rooms.name: Dam Lobby
rooms.description: This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring the dam. There are open doorways here to the north and east marked "Private", and there is a path leading south over the top of the dam.

rooms.name: Maintenance Room
rooms.description: This is what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood Control Dam #3. Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a group of buttons colored blue, yellow, brown, and red. There are doorways to the west and south.

rooms.name: Dam Base
rooms.description: You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3, which looms above you and to the north. The river Frigid is flowing by here. Along the river are the White Cliffs which seem to form giant walls stretching from north to south along the shores of the river as it winds its way downstream.

rooms.name: Frigid River

exits.message: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.
The White Cliffs prevent your landing here.

rooms.description: You are on the Frigid River in the vicinity of the Dam. The river flows quietly here. There is a landing on the west shore.

rooms.name: Frigid River

exits.message: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.
There is no safe landing spot here.
The White Cliffs prevent your landing here.
Just in time you steer away from the rocks.

rooms.description: The river turns a corner here making it impossible to see the Dam. The White Cliffs loom on the east bank and large rocks prevent landing on the west.

rooms.name: Frigid River

exits.message: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

rooms.description: The river descends here into a valley. There is a narrow beach on the west shore below the cliffs. In the distance a faint rumbling can be heard.

rooms.name: White Cliffs Beach
rooms.description: You are on a narrow strip of beach which runs along the base of the White Cliffs. There is a narrow path heading south along the Cliffs and a tight passage leading west into the cliffs themselves.

rooms.name: White Cliffs Beach
rooms.description: You are on a rocky, narrow strip of beach beside the Cliffs. A narrow path leads north along the shore.

rooms.name: Frigid River

exits.message: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.
You can land either to the east or the west.

rooms.description: The river is running faster here and the sound ahead appears to be that of rushing water. On the east shore is a sandy beach. A small area of beach can also be seen below the cliffs on the west shore.

rooms.name: Frigid River

exits.message: You cannot go upstream due to strong currents.

rooms.description: The sound of rushing water is nearly unbearable here. On the east shore is a large landing area.

rooms.name: Shore
rooms.description: You are on the east shore of the river. The water here seems somewhat treacherous. A path travels from north to south here, the south end quickly turning around a sharp corner.

rooms.name: Sandy Beach
rooms.description: You are on a large sandy beach on the east shore of the river, which is flowing quickly by. A path runs beside the river to the south here, and a passage is partially buried in sand to the northeast.

rooms.name: Sandy Cave
rooms.description: This is a sand-filled cave whose exit is to the southwest.

exits.message: It's a long way...

rooms.name: On the Rainbow
rooms.description: You are on top of a rainbow (I bet you never thought you would walk on a rainbow), with a magnificent view of the Falls. The rainbow travels east-west here.

rooms.name: End of Rainbow
rooms.description: You are on a small, rocky beach on the continuation of the Frigid River past the Falls. The beach is narrow due to the presence of the White Cliffs. The river canyon opens here and sunlight shines in from above. A rainbow crosses over the falls to the east and a narrow path continues to the southwest.

rooms.name: Canyon Bottom
rooms.description: You are beneath the walls of the river canyon which may be climbable here. The lesser part of the runoff of Aragain Falls flows by below. To the north is a narrow path.

rooms.name: Rocky Ledge
rooms.description: You are on a ledge about halfway up the wall of the river canyon. You can see from here that the main flow from Aragain Falls twists along a passage which it is impossible for you to enter. Below you is the canyon bottom. Above you is more cliff, which appears climbable.

rooms.name: Canyon View

exits.message: Storm-tossed trees block your way.

rooms.description: You are at the top of the Great Canyon on its west wall. From here there is a marvelous view of the canyon and parts of the Frigid River upstream. Across the canyon, the walls of the White Cliffs join the mighty ramparts of the Flathead Mountains to the east. Following the Canyon upstream to the north, Aragain Falls may be seen, complete with rainbow. The mighty Frigid River flows out from a great dark cavern. To the west and south can be seen an immense forest, stretching for miles around. A path leads northwest. It is possible to climb down into the canyon from here.

rooms.name: Mine Entrance
rooms.description: You are standing at the entrance of what might have been a coal mine. The shaft enters the west wall, and there is another exit on the south end of the room.

rooms.name: Squeaky Room
rooms.description: You are in a small room. Strange squeaky sounds may be heard coming from the passage at the north end. You may also escape to the east.

rooms.name: Shaft Room

exits.message: You wouldn't fit and would die if you could.

rooms.description: This is a large room, in the middle of which is a small shaft descending through the floor into darkness below. To the west and the north are exits from this room. Constructed over the top of the shaft is a metal framework to which a heavy iron chain is attached.

rooms.name: Smelly Room
rooms.description: This is a small nondescript room. However, from the direction of a small descending staircase a foul odor can be detected. To the south is a narrow tunnel.

rooms.name: Gas Room
rooms.description: This is a small room which smells strongly of coal gas. There is a short climb up some stairs and a narrow tunnel leading east.

rooms.name: Ladder Top
rooms.description: This is a very small room. In the corner is a rickety wooden ladder, leading downward. It might be safe to descend. There is also a staircase leading upward.

rooms.name: Ladder Bottom
rooms.description: This is a rather wide room. On one side is the bottom of a narrow wooden ladder. To the west and the south are passages leaving the room.

rooms.name: Dead End
rooms.description: You have come to a dead end in the mine.

rooms.name: Timber Room

exits.else: You cannot fit through this passage with that load.

rooms.description: This is a long and narrow passage, which is cluttered with broken timbers. A wide passage comes from the east and turns at the west end of the room into a very narrow passageway. From the west comes a strong draft.

rooms.name: Drafty Room

exits.else: You cannot fit through this passage with that load.
You cannot fit through this passage with that load.

rooms.description: This is a small drafty room in which is the bottom of a long shaft. To the south is a passageway and to the east a very narrow passage. In the shaft can be seen a heavy iron chain.

rooms.name: Coal Mine
rooms.description: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.

rooms.name: Coal Mine
rooms.description: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.

rooms.name: Coal Mine
rooms.description: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.

rooms.name: Coal Mine
rooms.description: This is a nondescript part of a coal mine.

rooms.name: Slide Room
rooms.description: This is a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage, and there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. To the north is a small opening.

objects.name: crystal skull
objects.initialDescription: Lying in one corner of the room is a beautifully carved crystal skull. It appears to be grinning at you rather nastily.

objects.name: basket
objects.description: From the chain is suspended a basket.

objects.name: basket
objects.description: At the end of the chain is a basket.

objects.name: lunch
objects.description: A hot pepper sandwich is here.

objects.name: red hot brass bell
objects.description: On the ground is a red hot bell.

objects.name: black book
objects.initialDescription: On the altar is a large black book, open to page 569.
objects.text:
Commandment #12592

Oh ye who go about saying unto each:  "Hello sailor":
Dost thou know the magnitude of thy sin before the gods?
Yea, verily, thou shalt be ground between two stones.
Shall the angry gods cast thy body into the whirlpool?
Surely, thy eye shall be put out with a sharp stick!
Even unto the ends of the earth shalt thou wander and
Unto the land of the dead shalt thou be sent at last.
Surely thou shalt repent of thy cunning.

objects.name: sceptre
objects.description: An ornamented sceptre, tapering to a sharp point, is here.
objects.initialDescription: A sceptre, possibly that of ancient Egypt itself, is in the coffin. The sceptre is ornamented with colored enamel, and tapers to a sharp point.

objects.name: brown sack
objects.initialDescription: On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.

objects.name: chalice
objects.description: There is a silver chalice, intricately engraved, here.

objects.name: crystal trident
objects.initialDescription: On the shore lies Poseidon's own crystal trident.

objects.name: glass bottle
objects.initialDescription: A bottle is sitting on the table.

objects.name: gold coffin
objects.description: The solid-gold coffin used for the burial of Ramses II is here.

objects.name: huge diamond
objects.description: There is an enormous diamond (perfectly cut) here.

objects.name: jade figurine
objects.description: There is an exquisite jade figurine here.

objects.name: nasty knife
objects.initialDescription: On a table is a nasty-looking knife.

objects.name: burned-out lantern
objects.initialDescription: The deceased adventurer's useless lantern is here.

objects.name: leather bag of coins
objects.description: An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.

objects.name: brass lantern
objects.initialDescription: A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
objects.description: There is a brass lantern (battery-powered) here.

objects.name: leaflet
objects.description: A small leaflet is on the ground.
objects.text:
"WELCOME TO ZORK!

ZORK is a game of adventure, danger, and low cunning. In it you will explore some of the most amazing territory ever seen by mortals. No computer should be without one!"

objects.name: matchbook
objects.description: There is a matchbook whose cover says "Visit Beautiful FCD#3" here.
objects.text:
(Close cover before striking)

YOU too can make BIG MONEY in the exciting field of PAPER SHUFFLING!

Mr. Anderson of Muddle, Mass. says: "Before I took this course I was a lowly bit twiddler. Now with what I learned at GUE Tech I feel really important and can obfuscate and confuse with the best."

Dr. Blank had this to say: "Ten short days ago all I could look forward to was a dead-end job as a doctor. Now I have a promising future and make really big Zorkmids."

GUE Tech can't promise these fantastic results to everyone. But when you earn your degree from GUE Tech, your future will be brighter.

objects.name: painting
objects.initialDescription: Fortunately, there is still one chance for you to be a vandal, for on the far wall is a painting of unparalleled beauty.
objects.description: A painting by a neglected genius is here.

objects.name: pair of candles
objects.initialDescription: On the two ends of the altar are burning candles.

objects.name: pile of leaves
objects.description: On the ground is a pile of leaves.

objects.name: pile of plastic
objects.description: There is a folded pile of plastic here which has a small valve attached.

objects.name: platinum bar
objects.description: On the ground is a large platinum bar.

objects.name: pot of gold
objects.initialDescription: At the end of the rainbow is a pot of gold.

objects.name: prayer
objects.text: The prayer is inscribed in an ancient script, rarely used today. It seems to be a philippic against small insects, absent-mindedness, and the picking up and dropping of small objects. The final verse consigns trespassers to the land of the dead. All evidence indicates that the beliefs of the ancient Zorkers were obscure.

objects.name: red buoy
objects.initialDescription: There is a red buoy here (probably a warning).

objects.name: rope
objects.initialDescription: A large coil of rope is lying in the corner.

objects.name: rusty knife
objects.initialDescription: Beside the skeleton is a rusty knife.

objects.name: wooden door
objects.text: The engravings translate to "This space intentionally left blank."

objects.name: sword
objects.initialDescription: Above the trophy case hangs an elvish sword of great antiquity.

objects.name: ancient map
objects.initialDescription: In the trophy case is an ancient parchment which appears to be a map.
objects.text: The map shows a forest with three clearings. The largest clearing contains a house. Three paths leave the large clearing. One of these paths, leading southwest, is marked "To Stone Barrow".

objects.name: tan label
objects.text:
!!!!FROBOZZ MAGIC BOAT COMPANY!!!!

Hello, Sailor!

Instructions for use:

   To get into a body of water, say "Launch".
   To get to shore, say "Land" or the direction in which you want to maneuver the boat.

Warranty:

  This boat is guaranteed against all defects for a period of 76 milliseconds from date of purchase or until first used, whichever comes first.

Warning:
   This boat is made of thin plastic.
   Good Luck!

objects.name: thief
objects.description: There is a suspicious-looking individual, holding a large bag, leaning against one wall. He is armed with a deadly stiletto.

objects.name: torch
objects.initialDescription: Sitting on the pedestal is a flaming torch, made of ivory.

objects.name: tour guidebook
objects.initialDescription: Some guidebooks entitled "Flood Control Dam #3" are on the reception desk.
objects.text:
"	Flood Control Dam #3

FCD#3 was constructed in year 783 of the Great Underground Empire to harness the mighty Frigid River. This work was supported by a grant of 37 million zorkmids from your omnipotent local tyrant Lord Dimwit Flathead the Excessive. This impressive structure is composed of 370,000 cubic feet of concrete, is 256 feet tall at the center, and 193 feet wide at the top. The lake created behind the dam has a volume of 1.7 billion cubic feet, an area of 12 million square feet, and a shore line of 36 thousand feet.

The construction of FCD#3 took 112 days from ground breaking to the dedication. It required a work force of 384 slaves, 34 slave drivers, 12 engineers, 2 turtle doves, and a partridge in a pear tree. The work was managed by a command team composed of 2345 bureaucrats, 2347 secretaries (at least two of whom could type), 12,256 paper shufflers, 52,469 rubber stampers, 245,193 red tape processors, and nearly one million dead trees.

We will now point out some of the more interesting features of FCD#3 as we conduct you on a guided tour of the facilities:

        1) You start your tour here in the Dam Lobby. You will notice on your right that....

objects.name: troll
objects.description: A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages out of the room.

objects.name: trunk of jewels
objects.initialDescription: Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
objects.description: There is an old trunk here, bulging with assorted jewels.

objects.name: tube
objects.description: There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
objects.text:
---> Frobozz Magic Gunk Company <---
	  All-Purpose Gunk

objects.name: wall with engravings
objects.description: There are old engravings on the walls here.
objects.text: The engravings were incised in the living rock of the cave wall by an unknown hand. They depict, in symbolic form, the beliefs of the ancient Zorkers. Skillfully interwoven with the bas reliefs are excerpts illustrating the major religious tenets of that time. Unfortunately, a later age seems to have considered them blasphemous and just as skillfully excised them.

objects.name: ZORK owner's manual
objects.initialDescription: Loosely attached to a wall is a small piece of paper.
objects.text:
Congratulations!

You are the privileged owner of ZORK I: The Great Underground Empire, a self-contained and self-maintaining universe. If used and maintained in accordance with normal operating practices for small universes, ZORK will provide many months of trouble-free operation.

objects.name: bird's nest
objects.initialDescription: Beside you on the branch is a small bird's nest.

objects.name: jewel-encrusted egg
objects.initialDescription: In the bird's nest is a large egg encrusted with precious jewels, apparently scavenged by a childless songbird. The egg is covered with fine gold inlay, and ornamented in lapis lazuli and mother-of-pearl. Unlike most eggs, this one is hinged and closed with a delicate looking clasp. The egg appears extremely fragile.

objects.name: broken jewel-encrusted egg
objects.description: There is a somewhat ruined egg here.

objects.name: golden clockwork canary
objects.initialDescription: There is a golden clockwork canary nestled in the egg. It has ruby eyes and a silver beak. Through a crystal window below its left wing you can see intricate machinery inside. It appears to have wound down.

objects.name: broken clockwork canary
objects.initialDescription: There is a golden clockwork canary nestled in the egg. It seems to have recently had a bad experience. The mountings for its jewel-like eyes are empty, and its silver beak is crumpled. Through a cracked crystal window below its left wing you can see the remains of intricate machinery. It is not clear what result winding it would have, as the mainspring seems sprung.
